statement: In Linux's DualSense common effects block, validity byte offset 0 bit 7 gates the route selector in audio-control offset 7 bits 4-5. Selector 0 means stereo headphone L/R; 1 duplicates left into both headphones; 2 maps left to both headphone sinks and right to internal speaker; 3 routes right to speaker with both headphones muted. SDL names the corresponding common-block byte 7 audio-enable bits but does not encode or validate the selector in the cited effects path; no independent semantic corroboration. USB common block begins after report 0x02; Linux BT uses the same common struct in report 0x31.

applicability.scope: Consumer source semantics and kernel routing intent only; SDL field-name agreement does not independently establish route interpretation.
